title: Orchestration timetable and cut criteria playbook for integrated inference stack
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Objective: Create a concrete, timeboxed playbook that coordinates milestones, scope-lock signals, cut criteria, and release notes across API, Console, and Runtime teams for the April 2026 integrated release. The playbook must be operational (runbook style) — not just aspirational — and include explicit ownership, decision gates, and fallback plans.

Scope: milestone calendar, scope freeze rules, cut criteria for features/bugfixes/docs, release notes coordination template, cross-team communication cadence, risk/rollback criteria, and post-launch monitoring signals. Covers hosted API, Redwood Console UI changes, runtime optimizations and backend infra changes required for the release.

Deliverables: a) Milestone calendar (week-by-week cut and canary windows). b) Scope-lock checklist for PM/Eng/Design/Docs/SRE. c) Cut decision matrix (severity/customer-impact/perf/regression rules). d) Release notes matrix mapping features to release channels and owners. e) A runbook for go/no-go decision with telemetry signals and rollback steps. f) Stakeholder comms calendar and templates.

Acceptance criteria: timeline agreed by ENG/Design/SRE by 2026-03-18; scope-lock checklist signed off by all owners; cut criteria published in shared Confluence; release notes template and primary owners assigned; roll-forward and rollback criteria validated in test canary; documented comms runway for customers and internal teams.

Constraints & trade-offs: balancing latency/perf regressions in runtime changes (may need to cut less critical runtime kernels) vs feature completeness on Console. Recommend two-tier cut: hard cut (blocks shipping) and soft cut (deferable into next minor release).

Primary risks: late-performance regressions from runtime kernel changes, Console UX blockers for new API fields, docs/outreach lag that impacts customer communication. Mitigation plan included in runbook.
release_notes_coordination: Owner: @Sophie Chen (Docs). Template created in Drive. Each feature must provide: summary, impact, migration steps, rollbacks, metrics to watch, and support playbook. Docs owner to compile first draft by 2026-03-22. PMs to approve content for each feature. Release notes channel will be staged: internal dev digest -> customer-facing release blog -> changelog entry. Identify customer-facing breaking changes by 2026-03-18.
rollout_strategy: Phased rollout: internal dogfood -> limited canary (10% traffic) with runtime telemetry and error budgets -> regional ramp -> global. Canary windows: 48h stability baseline with automated SLO checks. Fallback: automatic traffic re-route to previous runtime variant (runtime-1.20) and feature-flag disable for Console/API fields. SW rollback playbook linked in attachments.
